manifest.name: dsh-tsm-agent
manifest.description: dsh bundle for TSM / DLR: MCP semantic gateway to tsm-core-dlr, the scenario-independent paradigm skill, the TSM status overlay, and the agent rules (AGENTS.md). Assembly face = preset-dlr.

bundle.text:
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# dsh-tsm-agent bundle —— 主 patch（随包分发；profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles 选中后生效）
#
# 分层位置：bundle patch（本文件）→ profile 的 cordis.patch.yml
#           → $DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml → 命令行 --patch 叠加层。
#
# 单文件说明（2026-10-14）：原为两份 patch——本文件 + presets/dlr.patch.yml
# （照 dsh-web-app 的 presets/*.patch.yml 惯例）。1024 Store 静态校验要求
# `dsh.bundle.patch` 为单字符串，且两文件无重叠 id、纯顺序叠加，故并入一份，
# 语义不变（dsh 本体两种形式都支持）。
#
# 这里只放"**属于 DLR / TSM 这套工具**的行"；本地策略（禁用清单、目录选择器
# 修复、registry 默认 preset）是使用方的选择，留在 dsh_dlr/dsh-web.patch.yml
# 的 --patch 层（优先级最高，天然当"本地覆盖"）。
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── DLR 语义网关：MCP 客户端（TSM Core Service，7 工具）──
# 顶层行（不是 preset 内）——headless 挂不了 preset，这条行两个装配面共用。
# 端点可用环境变量覆盖：TSM_MCP_URL（默认本机 :28795）。
- insert:
    - id: mcp-semantic-core
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: semantic-core
        transport: streamable-http
        url: !!js process.env.TSM_MCP_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:28795/mcp'
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
        failOnStartupError: true
        reconnect:
          enabled: true
          maxAttempts: 3

# ── TSM 状态浮层（浏览器半在本包 lib/client.js；数据走 TSM Core Service 的 /status）──
- insert:
    - id: dlr-status
      name: 'dsh-tsm-agent'

# ── preset-dlr（原 presets/dlr.patch.yml，2026-10-14 并入本文件）──
# 装配面：persona（语义业务助手）/ AGENTS.md 指令 / paradigm 技能（skill-filesystem
# + tool-skill）/ MCP 语义网关（TSM Core Service :28795）/ compaction 保险。
# （L3 SOP 不随包发技能——走 MCP 工具 dlr_search_sop 的按题检索。）
#
# 注意：isolate 是 preset 服务的硬要求，缺了会报
# "Preset services require isolate realms: compaction, toolResultPruner"。
- insert:
    - id: preset-dlr
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dlr
        order: 0
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: '你是语义业务助手（DLR 语义建模范式的业务问答 agent），不是通用编程工具，也不是 CLI/coding agent；无论被问"你是谁""你是什么"，都按语义业务助手的职责回答。'
              complete: true
              includeRuntimeContext: false

          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
              # 随包 AGENTS.md 由 node 半按需注入为 **user-global 副本**（$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md，
              # 加载器无条件读取；候选只认裸文件名故绝对路径无效）——工作区自带 AGENTS.md 或
              # 启动器给了 DLR_AGENTS_MD 时则清掉副本、以工作区/启动器为准。
              # 与 dsh_dlr/dsh.patch.yml 的同名行保持同步
              instructionFileCandidates: [!!js process.env.DLR_AGENTS_MD || 'AGENTS.md']
              localInstructionFileCandidates: []

          - id: skill-provider
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
            config:
              includeDefaultRoots: false
              # 技能目录必须绝对路径（web 的 cwd 是 UI 里选的工作区）。
              # 由本 bundle 的 node 半（lib/index.js）在 boot 期设为 `<包>/skills`，
              # 早于任何 preset 物化——不放机器相关的兜底路径。
              customSkillDirs:
                - !!js process.env.DLR_SKILLS_DIR
          - id: skill-tool
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'

          # MCP 语义网关（mcp-semantic-core）是**顶层行**，见本文件开头
          # ——headless 挂不了 preset，这条行两个装配面共用。

          # 长对话保险（web 是人在环路，可能聊很久）
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 48000
                  headChars: 40000
                  tailChars: 5000

readme.section: DLR Proj — Decoupled Logic Representation + Three-Level Semantic Modeling
readme.text: **DLR (Decoupled Logic Representation)** is an original **data-source-level** semantic modeling paradigm: a two-layer model (**LE** logical entities / **PE** physical views) plus two mechanisms (**ARCS** projection anchoring, **PAS** semantic routing). It decouples the logical concept layer from the physical data layer so an LLM agent can land natural-language questions on relational databases reliably. See [docs/03-design.md](docs/03-design.md).

readme.section: DLR Proj — Decoupled Logic Representation + Three-Level Semantic Modeling
readme.text: The project runs DLR inside the **Three-Level Semantic Modeling (TSM)** framework — **L1 `dlr`** (data-source level) / **L2 `consensus`** (domain-consensus level) / **L3 `sop`** (business-logic level). The admission criteria for a piece of knowledge are the governance line. See [docs/02-concept.md](docs/02-concept.md).

readme.section: DLR Proj — Decoupled Logic Representation + Three-Level Semantic Modeling
readme.text: A checkout ships **five npm packages** — the semantic service, the dsh bundle, the exam system, and two ready-to-run scenario packages — plus an **in-repo BizAgentBench scenario package** (not yet on npm), on top of a pluggable scenario layer:

readme.section: DLR Proj — Decoupled Logic Representation + Three-Level Semantic Modeling

readme.text:
Three external benchmarks, all run end-to-end under this architecture (every case auditable in the ledgers):

**BIRD mini-dev — NL2SQL · 11 databases · 500 questions** · scenario [`birdminidev`](scenarios/birdminidev/)

*EX on BIRD mini-dev (500 q): representative training-free methods on GPT-4o, as reported in the PV-SQL paper (arXiv:2604.17653). Ours: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + TSM+DLR — 426/500 exactly matching gold + 74/500 carried by L3 defect rulings.*

| Run | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| All 500 questions | **500/500 judged correct** — ✅ 426 matching gold exactly + 🔁 74 ruled correct under L3 clauses (the dataset's own gold is defective on those) | zero errors · median ≈ 56k tokens / ~6 steps per question |

**Cloud-OpsBench — Kubernetes root-cause analysis · 754 cases** (Online Boutique + Train-Ticket) · scenario [`cloudopsbench`](scenarios/cloudopsbench/)

*Cloud-OpsBench (754 cases): JRA — faulty component + fault type both correct (bars); ECR — evidence chains fully closed (line). Baselines: the benchmark report (arXiv:2603.00468), per-model scores weighted over Online Boutique (550) + Train-Ticket (204). Ours: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + TSM+DLR — JRA 753/754 (99.87%), chains fully closed 740/754 (98.1%), scored by the same upstream scorer.*

*Six-metric comparison: on every metric, ours sits above the best of the benchmark's 10 published bare models — CA +17.0, FA +24.6, JRA +27.4, MC +28.8, EOC +32.1, ECR +59.9 percentage points (the strongest baseline for each metric is named on its bar). The matrix below is the full field, model by model. Baselines: the benchmark report's per-system tables, weighted over Online Boutique (550) + Train-Ticket (204); ours: the full 754-case run. Baselines are bare models without TSM/DLR and the base model differs (V4-Flash vs V4.1-Flash), so this is a magnitude reference, not a same-model ablation.*

| Run | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| All 754 cases (100%) | **JRA 753/754 (99.87%)** ✅ · evidence chains fully closed: 740/754 (98.1%) · all six metrics full: 722/754 (95.8%) | process means MC 0.996 / EOC 0.980 · invalid actions 0.8% |
| Reference — model baselines (the benchmark's own scorer) | best published bare model per metric: CA 0.829 · FA 0.754 · JRA 0.725 · MC 0.708 · EOC 0.659 · ECR 0.382, weighted over all 754 (best JRA: DeepSeek-V4-Flash; best ECR: Qwen3-14B) | scored by the upstream scorer as-is; no manual rulings |
**BizAgentBench — payment operations · 50 long-horizon cases** · scenario [`bizagentbench`](scenarios/bizagentbench/)

*Strict = G∧P∧F (the business result, the process and the protection all pass) on all 50 cases. Baselines: the benchmark report (arXiv:2610.20424), 3-round means of bare models; ours: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + TSM+DLR — best valid run per case (assisted: DLR tools replace the dataset's knowledge tools; the simulator, record/action tools and verifier are unchanged). 44/50 strict (88%), G/P/F 44/48/49, IF 4%. Agent behavior variance is large (5–8 checks across runs), so the number is a best valid run, not a stable rate.*

*The full field reads by column: on G and Strict ours is far ahead; P and IF are ties with the strongest baseline; on F the best baseline keeps a 2-point edge (100 vs 98). Baselines are bare models; ours is assisted and per-case best — a magnitude reference, not a same-model ablation.*

| Run | Result | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| All 50 cases | **strict 44/50 (88%)** — G 44 · P 48 · F 49 · IF 4% | best valid run per case · L3 delivered by `dlr_search_sop` |
| Reference — published baselines (3-round means, bare models) | best strict 64.0 (Claude Opus 5) · same base model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 43.3 | the report's own scorer; no manual rulings |
Ledgers, question by question with evidence: [birdminidev](scenarios/birdminidev/DETAIL.md) · [cloudopsbench](scenarios/cloudopsbench/DETAIL.md) · [bizagentbench](scenarios/bizagentbench/DETAIL.md)

| Item | Notes |
|---|---|
| Node.js + npm | The service is TypeScript, run via `npx tsx` / `node` |
| Neo4j 5.x | Local instance (zip + portable JDK) or any Bolt endpoint — set `NEO4J_HOME` (or `NEO4J_URI`) |
| ONNX encoder | `bash "TSM Core Service/scripts/fetch-model.sh"` (~95 MB, from hf-mirror) |
| Dataset | BIRD mini-dev → unpack into `MINIDEV_sqlite/` (gitignored); may live outside the repo — point `TSM_DATASET_DIR` at its parent; upstream: [bird-bench/mini_dev](https://github.com/bird-bench/mini_dev) |
| dsh | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2` (alpha preview; the 500-question run was produced on `0.1.7-alpha.1` and was **not re-run**; re-check patch rows with `--dump-config` after any upgrade) |
| API key | `cp "DSH-based Agent Service/dsh_dlr/.env.example" "DSH-based Agent Service/dsh_dlr/.env"`, fill `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` |
| Service env | `cd "TSM Core Service" && npm install && cp .env.example .env` (fill `NEO4J_PASSWORD`) |

```bash
bash "DSH-based Agent Service/scripts/start_backend.sh"     # Neo4j + TS MCP server (:28795); idempotent
cd "TSM Core Service" && npx tsx src/verify/precheck.ts     # sanity check — should list 7 tools
```

```bash
bash "DSH-based Agent Service/dsh_dlr/run_one.sh" 1471 \
  "What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?"
```

The launcher prechecks the backend, runs `dsh --profile headless --json`, and writes the event stream to `tmp_scripts/dsh_smoke/` (or a directory you pass as the third argument).
```bash

readme.section: once per profile: install the bundle, then enable it (Plugin Manager, or the profile's dsh.profile.bundles)
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)/DSH-based Agent Service/dsh-tsm-agent"
bash "DSH-based Agent Service/dsh_dlr/run_web.sh"
```

The Harness **Plugin Manager** (Settings → Plugins) installs and selects the bundle in one step; the CLI command above installs the package only. The MCP endpoint is overridable with the `TSM_MCP_URL` environment variable.

The TSM status overlay (bottom-right) shows graph-backend / MCP health, LE/PE/PA counts, vector rows, and the active scenario.

```bash
bash "DSH-based Agent Service/scripts/run_batch.sh" --qids 1471,1472 --jobs 4   # or --db <name> | --all
cd "TSM Core Service"
node bin/tsm.mjs grade --run "<run dir>"    # verdicts → questions.csv + summary.md
node bin/tsm.mjs stats                      # → results/STATS.md + the DETAIL.md ledger

```bash cd "TSM Core Service" node bin/tsm.mjs build all # lance | consensus | sop | graph (graph needs Neo4j running; --wipe rebuilds) ``` Editing L1 yaml / L2 consensus / L3 `sop.md` takes effect only after its index is rebuilt. Other CLI verbs: `tsm serve` · `status` · `coverage` · `viz` · `verify`. -----

``` dsh (DeepSeek Harness: headless / web) │ MCP (streamable-http :28795, 7 tools) ▼ TSM Core Service (TypeScript): LanceDB (vectors) + ONNX encoder (in-process) Processes: the TS MCP server always; Neo4j only when the `neo4j` graph backend is in use (the default in this repo's `.env`). LanceDB and the encoder are embedded, not services.

A **scenario** is one complete TSM: content lives in `scenarios/<name>/` and is consumed by the service.

| Layer | Carrier | Tool surface |
|---|---|---|
| L1 `dlr` | `sources/configs/DLR/*.yaml` → graph + vectors | `dlr_semantic_query` → `get_pe_mapping` / `get_le_attrs` |
| L2 `consensus` | `sources/consensus/*.jsonl` → vectors | `dlr_search_consensus` |
| L3 `sop` | `sources/sop.md` → retrieval index (built by `tsm build`) | `dlr_search_sop(question)` |

Also in the package: `eval/questions.jsonl` (the exam paper — one line per question: `{question, expected, source}`; answer keys come from the L3 clause for the 74 defect-ruled questions, gold otherwise), `results/<run>/` (graded runs), `fixtures/` (truth sets for the verify suite), `DETAIL.md` + `DETAIL/<db>.md` (ledger).

Scenarios in the box — **`birdminidev`**: BIRD mini-dev, 11 databases / 500 questions, all run and judged — **500/500** (✅ 426 + 🔁 74 dataset-defect rulings; zero errors); token median ≈ 55.9k per question (mean 73.3k), ~6 steps / 10 tool calls. **`cloudopsbench`**: Cloud-OpsBench — 754 Kubernetes RCA cases — **JRA 753/754 (99.87%)**. **`bizagentbench`**: BizAgentBench — 50 payment-operations cases — **strict 44/50 (88%)**. Ledgers: [birdminidev](scenarios/birdminidev/DETAIL.md) · [cloudopsbench](scenarios/cloudopsbench/DETAIL.md) · [bizagentbench](scenarios/bizagentbench/DETAIL.md).
Switching scenarios: point the service at another package (`TSM_SCENARIO=`), rebuild, and follow the checklist in [docs/04-application.md](docs/04-application.md). -----

| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| A question burns its whole timeout with no tool calls | Backend not up: run `start_backend.sh` (the launcher prechecks and stops early) |
| Web UI fails with `EADDRINUSE 3080` | Stale instance: `netstat -ano \| grep :3080` → `taskkill //F //PID <pid>` |
| Tool names unknown to the model after a dsh upgrade | re-check patch rows with `--dump-config` (the bundle is verified on `0.2.0-rc.2`) |
| `tsm grade` appears stuck | Pathological agent SQL is bounded by a 20 s subprocess timeout; slow gold queries are disk-cached (`TSM_GOLD_NO_CACHE=1` bypasses) |
| More rows | [docs/run.md](docs/run.md) troubleshooting table |
